gen-dafont-dogica-gf-golos-text: Golos Text reads friendly and modern, its tall x-height filling the line with strokes of one width. Dogica sits on top as the heavy, widely tracked voice, a plain sans below keeping things steady word after word.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Approachable is the first thing you notice in the body text, and then Dogica barges in with its heavy, wide-tracked swagger. Hedvig Letters Sans keeps its small letters tall and its c wide open, so the heading earns its keep when big and brief.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-heebo: Dogica's lowercase climbs almost to capital height. Heebo gives it a sans-serif partner with a tall central band and curves that stop short, so the heavy heading finally has a quiet, steady neighbor.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-hind-guntur: Dogica comes in heavy, wide-tracked and commanding. Hind Guntur answers with a line like a drafting pen, no thick-thin shift at all, and that steadiness against the blunt heading is the pair's best trick.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-hind-madurai: Chunky, wide and loud on top, with a hushed gray hum below it. Hind Madurai keeps its lowercase filling the line, so use Dogica large and let the sans stay modest.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-hind-mysuru: Blunt, stretched out and a bit stern. Dogica shouts in wide-tracked heavy letters, while Hind Mysuru pours ink at one width, its lowercase pressing up to the ascenders, and it is far happier doing the quiet work of running text.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-hind-siliguri: Dogica is the heavy, commanding one, with lowercase rising near capital height and a wide tracking that spreads every word out. Hind Siliguri hums along gently, no thick-thin flicker anywhere.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara reads clean and professional, with spacious gaps in its rounded letters and tall bowls on the e and a. And Dogica supplies the muscle, so that heavy, wide-tracked heading against a flat, unswelling body line is where the pair is strongest.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-huninn: Heavy, wide and unapologetic up top. Huninn handles the quieter job, its curves matching the stems exactly while Dogica does the commanding, so one makes the statement and the other carries the reading.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-inter-tight: Dogica leads with heavy, widely tracked letters and lowercase that climbs close to capital height. But Inter Tight is the pair's anchor, its rope-like lines and short ascenders giving that loud heading a sober, modern sans to lean on.
